text: @goodandready/dsh-lanmode 为 DSH Web UI 提供局域网和远程访问。它可修复代理环境下的浏览器能力，也可开启独立监听器转发到本机 harness。功能包括手机二维码接入、mDNS 名称、PWA 移动端入口和 WAN 隧道控制，适合从手机或其他设备访问 DSH 的用户。无需 API 密钥；可按需设置访问范围和隧道凭据。

@goodandready/dsh-lanmode adds LAN and remote access to DSH Web UI. It can open a listener forwarding to the local harness, provide QR phone pairing, an mDNS name, PWA support, and WAN tunnel controls. Useful for reaching DSH from another device; no API key is needed.

@goodandready/dsh-lanmode 的功能「手机二维码接入」：生成本地网络访问链接和二维码，用户可用手机或平板扫码打开 DSH。通过 DSH 工具 mobileqr 触发，输出地址、端口和二维码内容。
@goodandready/dsh-lanmode 的功能「直连与反向代理接入」：根据配置以代理修复模式或独立监听模式接入 DSH；直连模式将外部请求转发到本机 harness。由插件启动时依据 mode 配置选择。
@goodandready/dsh-lanmode 的功能「PWA 移动端安装入口」：提供 Web App Manifest 与独立显示模式元数据，让移动浏览器可将 DSH 添加到主屏幕。浏览器请求 manifest 路由时返回应用清单。

@goodandready/dsh-lanmode README · ⚡ Overview & Features：`dsh-lanmode` brings seamless and secure local network (LAN) and WAN remote access to DeepSeek Harness:

@goodandready/dsh-lanmode README · ⚡ Overview & Features：1. **📱 Quick QR Popover**: Tap the smartphone icon in the sidebar footer (`Quick QR` in `sidebar.footer` / `sidebar.rail`) to open an interactive SVG QR code. Supports the `/mobileqr` chat tool and ASCII QR output.
2. **📲 PWA & Standalone Mode**: Serves `/dsh-lanmode/manifest.json` with `viewport-fit=cover` for full-screen mobile experience.
3. **🌐 Automatic mDNS (`dsh.local`)**: Built-in UDP 5353 responder announces `dsh.local` across the LAN automatically.
4. **🔐 Local Root CA & HTTPS**: Generates a 10-year Root CA and trusted SAN certificates (`dsh.local`, LAN IP, localhost). One-click download via `/dsh-lanmode/ca.crt`.
5. **🔔 Background Web Push & Notifications API**: Delivers system push notifications on agent turn end and approval requests.
6. **🛡️ Comprehensive Security & Authentication**:
   - Authentication passwords support plaintext and scrypt key derivation. Verified in constant time via `timingSafeEqual`.
   - LAN PIN protection with plaintext or `PBKDF2` stretching (`pbkdf2$sha512$100000$salt$hash`). Auto-lockout for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failures.
